decisions.reason: This desk system is strongly related to the firm's established office offer and, with in-house R&D, the firm has the knowledge base to learn from early market feedback and refine it.
A chair family is close to the firm's existing interior portfolio, so its existing design, material, and product-development capabilities make continuation more likely than withdrawal.
Although somewhat more niche, these floor cushions still build on the firm's established interior and material competences, giving management enough related knowledge to keep developing the product.
The sofa is close to the firm's lounge and living expertise, but the weaker website presence suggests a more cautious commitment, raising but not dominating the risk of withdrawal.
A high standing table fits the firm's office and conference orientation and the trend toward flexible workplaces, making it a natural product for the firm to retain.
A rug collection is comparatively distant from the firm's core furniture knowledge, so even with R&D the firm is less able to interpret early signals and improve it efficiently.
